title: Concept: Yarn immutable installs disabled
description: .yarnrc.yml declares an `enableImmutableInstalls=false` setting, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads an `enableImmutableInstalls=false` setting.
